episodes.synopsis: To save Earth, unlucky Ataru must win a high-stakes game of tag against a beautiful alien. Luckily his friend Shinobu has offered a helping hand (in marriage) as motivation!
episodes.title: Young Love on the Run / Between a Rock and a Hard Place

episodes.synopsis: Ataru can run, but he can't hide — not from Lum, and not from the gorgeous shrine maiden Sakura's eagle eyes. She can tell at a glance that he's in dire need of exorcism!
episodes.title: Present for You / The Yellow Ribbon of Happiness

episodes.synopsis: Two's company. Three's a crowd. And when a FOURTH party enters the Lum/Ataru/Shinobu situation? Things get pretty scary in Ataru's already complex love life!
episodes.title: Trouble Rains Down!! / Amazed in a Maze

episodes.synopsis: Lum ain't the only alien princess in town. The new arrival has her sights set on a certain boy — but her vassals are keeping a scandalous secret from their ruler!
episodes.title: Sealed with a Kiss!!

episodes.synopsis: Hellooooo, nurse! A new nurse just started working at Ataru's school, and she's a total babe… but wait. Does she look familiar?
episodes.title: The Glove of Love and Conflict / How I've Waited for You…

episodes.synopsis: They say all's fair in love and war, and that's why Lum drags Ataru kicking and screaming onto a battlefield!
episodes.title: Good Day for a Departure / Oyuki / Ataru Retires

episodes.synopsis: A monster lurks in the depths of the hotel pool, but it's not half as creepy as the ne'er-do-wells lurking around Nurse Sakura at the beach…
episodes.title: Home Is Where You Find It / Marine Garbage Disposal

episodes.synopsis: Is Ataru seeing double, or are there really two hot new transfer students at school? And what does the super cute newbie Ran want from him and Lum!?
episodes.title: Transfer Student Close Call... / Farewell Party Close Call...

episodes.synopsis: An ominous omen. A pessimistic portent. A scary sign. Call it whatever you want, but one thing is clear: Fate will not be kind to Ataru today!
episodes.title: To Kill with Love / Studying Mayhem

episodes.synopsis: Are aliens invading again? Nope — it's just Ataru, Meno and Lum’s mothers invading Parents’ Day! But a language barrier may turn this meeting of the moms into pure mania.
episodes.title: Parents' Day Horrors / Since Your Parting

episodes.synopsis: What’s this? A handkerchief? It smells divine, so it MUST belong to a total hottie. Definitely not a nightmare creature or anything like that. Ataru’s nose cannot be fooled!
episodes.title: Mendo Siblings!! / A Strange New Year at the Mendo Estate

episodes.synopsis: Lum’s cousin Ten thinks Lum should look for greener romantic pastures! And if Lum can’t see reason, Ten will burn her relationship with Ataru to the ground.
episodes.title: Ten Is Here / A Date for Just the Two of Us

episodes.synopsis: The girls in class aren’t the only snacks Ataru has his eye on. When teachers crack down on off-campus snacking, a no-holds-barred snack battle begins!
episodes.title: The Great Off-Campus Snack Battle / A Gift from Ten!

episodes.synopsis: All’s fair in love and… baseball? It’s time for a showdown on the baseball diamond! And once the dust settles, a “love letter” stirs up trouble.
episodes.title: That Mizunokoji Boy / Love Letter Trouble

episodes.synopsis: Lum and Ran are friends, but one can best describe their relationship as prickly.
episodes.title: Anko Pathos, the Taste of Love?! / Memories and a Close Call... / Adverse Effects

episodes.synopsis: Ataru and his friends were supposed to have a fun beach trip, but they find themselves swept up in Ryunosuke’s family drama instead!
episodes.title: Family Feud!! / Hello, Sailor Suit!!

episodes.synopsis: Ryunosuke teams up with three delinquents to help Shinobu ward off an unwanted suitor. Later, Ataru’s family must be careful what they wish for.
episodes.title: A Chest Full of Longing!! / Wish Upon a Star

episodes.synopsis: There is nothing suspicious about the lipstick Lum wants to put on Ataru. Nope, nothing suspicious at all. Later, Ataru’s class takes the dreaded Yaminabe food challenge!
episodes.title: Indelible Lipstick Magic!! / Lethal Attacks: Yaminabe!

episodes.synopsis: Pro tip: never hurt an octopus’ feelings and never give an oni pickled plums.
episodes.title: Magic Realm! Jungle of Terror / Pickled

episodes.synopsis: Three punks challenge Lum and her friends to a duel after stealing Benten’s precious chain.
episodes.title: Recovering That Which Was Lost

episodes.synopsis: Lum and her friends worry the past will come back to haunt them. Later, Mendo’s life becomes much more complicated thanks to a voodoo doll.
episodes.title: Cosmo Teacher CAO-2 / Ooh, Scary! Voodoo Doll

episodes.synopsis: Lum is quite the handful, no matter what size she is. Later, a shapeshifting fox takes a liking to Shinobu.
episodes.title: Big Bottle, Little Bottle / When Love Strikes

episodes.synopsis: The finalists have different motives. Lum wants Ataru’s attention, Ran wants to get in Lum’s way, Shinobu and Sakura want the money, and Ryunosuke has something to prove.
episodes.title: Title Match!! The Tomo-1 Queen Contest
